verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is a versioned collection of agent skill and plugin instruction files, installed into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and similar agents, that guide agents through Ledger, wiki, planning and Ralph-loop workflows. It is not a running service that emits events, so registrable outbound webhook subscriptions are outside its product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any webhook or event-subscription capability that would make the axis apply.
